commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Adrian Cordero Vega has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+4' 1 - 1 Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) perfectly latches on to a cross from the set piece, controls the ball with one touch and releases a great effort into the left side of the goal and past the goalkeeper!
90+4' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) takes a direct free kick.
90+2' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) offside.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Javier Marton (Ath Bilbao) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90' Eray Comert (Valladolid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Adrian Cordero Vega had an easy-decision to make.
89' Paulo Pezzolano has decided to make a change. Eray Comert (Valladolid) replaces Stanko Juric.
89' Substitution. Raul Moro makes his way off the pitch and Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) comes on as his replacement.
87' A cross from a corner kick by Ath Bilbao is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
86' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a throw-in.
83' Great individual play by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) ends with a shot from distance that flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
81' Adrian Cordero Vega blows his whistle as Javier Marton (Ath Bilbao) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
80' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Nico Serrano will be replaced by Javier Marton (Ath Bilbao).

79' 1 - 0 Goal – 1:0! Ivan Sanchez sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Raul Moro (Valladolid) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the bottom left corner.
78' Mario Martin (Valladolid) picks up a yellow card.
76' A substitution has been made. Kike Perez goes off and Mario Martin (Valladolid) comes on.
76' The attendance for today's match is 23515.

75' Oscar de Marcos plays a pass to Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
75' The ball is cleared after Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
72' David Torres (Valladolid) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
71' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Adrian Cordero Vega had a clear view and blows his whistle.
69' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
68' Raul Moro (Valladolid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
67' Kike Perez (Valladolid) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
66' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
64' Substitution. Alex Berenguer will be replaced by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
64' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
62' Paulo Pezzolano prepares a substitution. Mamadou Sylla is replaced by Marcos Andre (Valladolid).
61' The referee signals a substitution. Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) is brought on as a substitute for Anuar.
59' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Karl Hein, who smothers the ball.
58' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
58' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
55' Ath Bilbao continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.

55' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Adrian Cordero Vega stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
54' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
51' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
48' Kike Perez (Valladolid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
46' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor makes a half-time substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta comes on in place of Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives a chance to Alvaro Djalo and Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) is off.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) comes off for Mikel Vesga.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Adrian Cordero Vega has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Adrian Cordero Vega shows a yellow card to Paulo Pezzolano (Valladolid) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
45+2' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Raul Moro (Valladolid) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar.
44' The corner is swung in but Valladolid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
43' The booking goes to Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
43' Confusion here but it seems that referee Adrian Cordero Vega has changed his mind following the VAR review and reversed the red card shown to Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).

41' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao), but referee Adrian Cordero Vega must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!

39' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
36' A raking crossfield pass from Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
35' None of the Ath Bilbao players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
34' A lofted cross from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
32' Luis Perez (Valladolid) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
31' Valladolid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
29' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
26' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
24' Raul Moro (Valladolid) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
24' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
21' A quickly taken corner by Ath Bilbao.
19' Adrian Cordero Vega shows a yellow card to Anuar (Valladolid) for his blatant foul.
19' A crossfield pass from Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates.
17' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
16' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post.
15' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.

12' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) makes contact with a cross and strikes a shot towards the bottom left corner that lacks the power to find the back of the net, but the goalkeeper still has to pull off a marvellous diving save to keep his effort out.
11' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
9' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valladolid comes to nothing.

6' Raul Moro (Valladolid) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Julen Agirrezabala makes a comfortable save. Valladolid force a corner. They send men into the box.
6' Valladolid take a short corner kick.
5' A crossfield pass from Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates.
4' Julen Agirrezabala (Ath Bilbao) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
2' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
1' The first half has just begun.
Valladolid will kick-off.
Adrian Cordero Vega is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
